units.source_text: 他们俩跟前那条浅浅的清泷川，潺潺的流水声隐约可闻。

en.t: In front of the two of them, the shallow Kiyotaki River flowed, and the murmuring sound of the water could be faintly heard.

units.source_text: 秀男环顾了一下两岸的杉山，然后说：
